diff: Requested change: Record which of these genre and phase functions realise The First Crosser. Change nothing else.

Revised architecture summary (not causal rationale): A fourteen-Book optimistic architecture whose governing engine is risk transfer, not detection and not politics. A ward's signature is the act that moves the consequence of being wrong off the builder, off the crown, and onto one named person who cannot indemnify herself. Every other mechanism in this proposal exists to distribute, disguise, dispute, or finally share that transfer. Causal organization is proposed as a primary engine with layered subordinates - an agent proposal, because the brief declares no engine hierarchy, complexity or causal distribution: the signature-burden engine owns the series, and beneath it sit the unverifiable-certificate engine (trust only ever reaches a signer secondhand), precedent memory (what an old signature still binds), succession (who is permitted to sign next), the crossing-public engine (use as the only test the guild did not write), the compressed-labor engine (one name summarizing judgements made by people who are never named), the standing market (a reputation is an asset, therefore a thing that can be bought), and capture pressure (crown and contractors buying the function of certification while refusing its liability). Two layers are deliberately outside that ownership. Material load - the span itself, indifferent to paper - is the unparented dispute: a span can be certified and fail, or purchased and hold, and the series must live with both. Capture pressure is a competing claimant rather than a servant, which is why the crown's exclusion never becomes a war. The emotional promise is earned trust: not relief, not safety, but the specific joy-plus-fear of having decided to rely on a stranger and having been right, with the cost still visible. The progression runs from elegant unease, through anger at purchase, into somatic fear, disgust at institutions, grief for forty unknowing years, and out into a hard, shared consent rather than restored innocence. Book 12 is the structural center: the false binary of close-or-keep is replaced by the recognition that only a ward can unbind a span, the only ward whose signature binds the Old Span was bought, and therefore no verdict is available - so the decision becomes a re-allocation of risk to the party that has actually been underwriting it for forty years, the crossing public, knowingly and at visible cost. The series never says certification is meaningless; it says a certificate must name its true bearer. No basic-emotion word appears in the brief, so every emotion target here is agent_proposed; no genre is declared, so every genre contract is a working framing. All of this is a noncanonical proposal.
